rationale: 407 International Inc. is the parent infrastructure platform and wholly owns the 407 ETR concessionaire. PSP Investments acquired a direct 7.51% interest through Spectre Infra LP on June 6, 2025. The current cap table is fully disclosed at the company level: Cintra 48.29%, the CPP Investments-controlled institutional block 44.20%, and PSP 7.51%.
recommendedChanges: Create one canonical 407 International Inc. company with 407 ETR as an alias.
Add PSP Investments as an active 7.51% owner from 2025-06-06 through Spectre Infra Limited Partnership.
Add Cintra/Ferrovial as an active 48.29% owner and the CPP Investments-controlled block as an active 44.20% owner, preserving the disclosed co-investor limitation.
Record AtkinsRéalis, Macquarie/Intoll and CDPQ as former owners with their supported historical periods.
Do not split the concession company, tolling/service entities or financing subsidiaries into separate PortCos.
unresolvedQuestions: MICI-parent co-investor identities, entry dates and look-through stakes are not publicly disclosed.
